title: Hansha de Spark! (Demo)
overview:
The Sparkers' Heated Battle Begins Now.

The Sparkers gathered in the Sparking Colosseum now wage their heated battle.

- Focused on attacking! Equipped with the Skill Battle System
- Come back even after being defeated! The Transforming Monster System
